detail.longDescription: Making vertices move is easy. Making the motion art-directable, cheap at scene scale, and correct across the entire render pipeline is the skill real production demands. I published a practical, readable guide to vertex-stage motion in games: what the stage is (and isn't) good at, the building blocks every piece of motion is made from, and the production checks 📖 https://www. artstation.com/blogs/degged/PQ bOA/vertex-animation-in-games-how-to-make-it-art-directable-performant-and-shippable # vertexanimation # gamedev # shaders # technicalartist # unity # gamedevelopment # programming # indiedev
